extracted.name: German Pancakes 🥞
instruction_lines: Pre heat oven to 425 degrees F
As oven preheats, put the butter in a 13x9x2in. Place in oven.
Put all of the other ingredients in a large bowl and mix until smooth
Take out the pan and pour the mix in then place back in for 22-27 min until a golden brown
